reviews.review_description: It needs a bit of polish, but the core gameplay is awesome! Make the status screens a bit smaller please.

developer_response.body:
Thank you for the early review! We're glad you are enjoying it and the polish is coming in good time!  
As for the screens feedback, we'll certainly look into it - in the meantime there is an option in the settings to change player height if the screens are obstructing your view too much.
